units.spine: No building here is meant for buying and selling in quantity, so a stranger looking for one is sent to a door.
Anything another place would hand to an office is done here by whoever already has a trade.
Stock and people have been drawn inside a line the able-bodied can hold, and outside that line the ground is worked by nobody.
What is wrong here has been wrong long enough that the place works at it in its own time.
This is as far as the place bends before it becomes something else.
The worsening here is steady rather than sudden, and each season costs a little more than the one before.
At Warmholz the year closes near enough to level that the closing is watched.
Danger here is counted from what comes back, and what does not come back is counted as nothing.
The place pays its own way on terms nobody here chose.
Little stands between the houses here and whatever comes at them, and a place this size usually has more.
Nobody here carries arms as their work, so the keeping of the perimeter falls to the households.
What lives beyond the fields is no one's duty here, and whoever goes after it goes by choice.
More goes on here than anyone is charged with noticing, though none of it is hidden particularly well.
Nothing here is spare, and a stranger sees that before anybody here says it.
Magic here is the lamp at the gate.
Food is the one thing here that nobody has to think about.
Nobody arrives here except along the road.
A handful of roofs stands here, and the ground under them is the reason for the place.
People here are tied to one another as people in any settled place are, with no tie that belongs to this one alone.
One matter here is left to whoever picks it up, and no standing arrangement takes it off them.
